name: HackDao sell fee debited from a skimming pair's reserve
summary: HackDao's _transfer() charges its 12% sell fee on top of the amount from the sender's balance whenever the recipient is its USDT pair, so a skim() from another pair to that pair takes the fee out of the skimming pair's reserves. The attacker sent HackDao to the WBNB pair, skimmed it into the USDT pair and synced, shrinking the WBNB pair's HackDao reserve, then skimmed the tokens back and swapped the surplus for the pair's WBNB.
notes: Victims are the HackDao/WBNB pair 0xcd4cdaa8 and the HackDao/USDT pair 0xbdb426a2; HackDao is unpriced and crashed, so it is valued at the WBNB and USDT realised (rule 12).

The only HackDao Transfers from the WBNB pair to the USDT pair are the anchor, a repeat by the same sender and a copycat 0xeffab2e0 (log scan from deployment to head); campaign.mjs could not finish over the token's 24k Transfers.
Later owner calls changed fee ratios, referral levels and the pool address; none is needed by the exploit, so the token's deployment is the reset.
